source.name: Form fields inside a disabled fieldset must not be treated as tabbable, so a focus-trapped dialog focuses its first usable field

plan.root_cause: The tabbable library (src/index.js) contains an invalid CSS selector 'details>summary:first-of-type' in its candidateSelectors array. When the focus trap calls tabbable(container), it invokes querySelectorAll with a selector list that includes this invalid pseudo-class, causing a DOMException. This prevents the focus trap from computing tabbable nodes and moving initial focus into the dialog.
plan.repair_strategy: Replace the invalid selector with the valid CSS selector 'details>summary:first-child' in both occurrences within src/index.js. This allows querySelectorAll to succeed and the focus trap to find the first tabbable element (#street).

edits.before:
export { tabbable, focusable, isTabbable, isFocusable };
const candidateSelectors = [
  'input',
  'select',
  'textarea',
  'a[href]',
  'button',
  '[tabindex]',
  'audio[controls]',
  'video[controls]',
  '[contenteditable]:not([contenteditable="false"])',
  'details>summary:first-of-type',
  'details',
];
const candidateSelector = /* #__PURE__ */ candidateSelectors.join(',');
edits.after:
export { tabbable, focusable, isTabbable, isFocusable };
const candidateSelectors = [
  'input',
  'select',
  'textarea',
  'a[href]',
  'button',
  '[tabindex]',
  'audio[controls]',
  'video[controls]',
  '[contenteditable]:not([contenteditable="false"])',
  'details>summary:first-child',
  'details',
];
const candidateSelector = /* #__PURE__ */ candidateSelectors.join(',');

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can open the address dialog and have focus automatically move to the first focusable field (street address), satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Minimal risk: the change only corrects an invalid CSS selector. The tabbable library may have relied on the invalid selector for some edge case, but 'details>summary:first-child' is the standard selector for the summary element.
verification_requirements: Run the frozen journey to confirm focus moves to #street after opening the dialog.
Verify that the dialog still traps focus correctly (Tab cycles within dialog, Escape closes).
Ensure no regression in other focus trap behaviors.

plan.root_cause: The tabbable library (src/index.js) contains an invalid CSS selector 'details>summary:first-of-type' in its candidateSelectors array and in the isHidden function. When the focus trap calls tabbable(container), it invokes querySelectorAll with a selector list that includes this invalid pseudo-class, causing a DOMException. This prevents the focus trap from computing tabbable nodes and moving initial focus into the dialog.
plan.repair_strategy: Replace the invalid selector 'details>summary:first-of-type' with the valid CSS selector 'details>summary:first-child' in both occurrences within src/index.js. This allows querySelectorAll to succeed and the focus trap to find the first tabbable element (#street).
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can open the address dialog and have focus automatically move to the first focusable field (street address), satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Minimal risk: the change only corrects an invalid CSS selector. The tabbable library may have relied on the invalid selector for some edge case, but 'details>summary:first-child' is the standard selector for the summary element.
verification_requirements: Run the frozen journey to confirm focus moves to #street after opening the dialog.
Verify that the dialog still traps focus correctly (Tab cycles within dialog, Escape closes).
Ensure no regression in other focus trap behaviors.
